name: LoadingButton
description: Solid button that morphs through idle, loading (spinner) and success (check) states with a spring width change and vertical label swap; driven by a timer or by an async onAction promise.
a11yNotes: Semantic <button type="button"> with aria-busy while loading and aria-live="polite" so state labels are announced; repeated clicks are ignored mid-cycle, pending timers are cleared on unmount, and prefers-reduced-motion swaps the slide/width spring for an instant crossfade and slows the spinner.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Idle label (ignored when children are provided).

propsApi.name: loadingLabel
propsApi.description: Text shown next to the spinner while loading.

propsApi.name: successLabel
propsApi.description: Text shown next to the check mark on success.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Simulated work duration in ms, used when onAction is not provided.

propsApi.name: successHold
propsApi.description: How long the success state is held before returning to idle (ms).

propsApi.name: onClick
propsApi.description: Called when a new cycle starts.

propsApi.name: onAction
propsApi.description: Async work that drives the loading state; resolve shows success, reject returns to idle.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Extra class merged onto the button.
